teachingQuestion: How should access change as a person, device, or service changes state?
focalInsight: Provisioning and deprovisioning are state transitions with approvals, downstream effects, and evidence—not one-time account tickets.
title: Identity and access lifecycle
caption: Joiner, mover, and leaver events trigger controlled state changes and verification.
altSummary: An identity moves from request to active access; role changes trigger reconciliation, elevation is temporary, and risk or departure leads to suspension and complete retirement.
textFallback: Start with an approved request and provision least privilege. A mover event removes old access and adds newly approved access. JIT elevation expires back to the normal state. Risk, incident, or departure suspends and then retires the identity, revoking downstream permissions, sessions, credentials, keys, and physical access.
